descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S13 Baseline survey x census x state: no patients yet, first patient added, patients seeded before first sign-in, answered, a shared browser, Not now over the following days

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 A one-time baseline survey is shown before the physician adds their first patient (UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 2; TFA-94514 AC 4; TFA-94609 AC 7)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Account 1: fresh, no patients. Account 2: fresh, one Hospital patient and one resident seeded before first sign-in. Accounts 3 and 4: fresh, no patients, signed in one after the other in the same browser context (localStorage kept). Account 5: fresh, no patients, browser clock under the harness's control

When R1-R4 account 1: look at the Hospital and Nursing Home lists; add the first patient without touching the card; look again; start the survey, answer, submit; reload both lists. R5 account 2: look at both lists. R6 account 3 taps Not now and signs out; account 4 signs in on the same browser and looks at the list. …

Then R1 before any patient: the baseline survey is offered (on the first screen the physician sees). R4 after the answer: never offered again on either list, also after reload, and exactly one baseline row with clearly named keys. R6: account 4 is offered the baseline before its first patient (the survey is per physician). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 2 + TFA-94514 AC 4 for R1, R4 and R6; post-run read: surveyResponses baseline = 1 for account 1 with patientsPerDay 14, preRoundMinutesPerPatientBefore 5_to_10, noteMinutesPerPatientBefore under_5, patientListMethodBefore emr, writtenHandoffFrequencyBefore sometimes, comments; none for accounts 3 and 4. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-06/S13

Baseline survey x census x state: no patients yet, first patient added, patients seeded before first sign-in, answered, a shared browser, Not now over the following days

Tickets: TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa); TFA-94609 Pilot Surveys (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Local QA stack only (round-companion-wt-qa at main 43c38a4f, the build dev runs); brand-new @roundai.test accounts; survey, usage and patient-activity rows read with the local admin key; no model call from these specs (the Convex socket answers generateHandoff in the browser and refuses every other ai/* action; tripwire: no Generate). Re-run on 43c38a4f because #86 moved Not now from one browser-wide localStorage key to the server (surveyDismissals) and added the re-offer rules. Judged 6/6: R1 account 1 (no patients), signed in through the real form and the consent screen, is offered 'Before you start: a 2-minute baseline survey' on the first Hospital list and on the Nursing Home list; R4 after answering (14, '5–10 min', 'Under 5 min', 'EMR list', 'Sometimes', comment) the card is not offered again on either list, also after reloads (status baseline.answeredAt set), and the account has exactly one surveyResponses baseline row {patientsPerDay 14, preRoundMinutesPerPatientBefore 5_to_10, noteMinutesPerPatientBefore under_5, patientListMethodBefore emr, writtenHandoffFrequencyBefore sometimes, comments}; accounts that did not answer (2, 3, 4) have no baseline row. Recorded only: R2 (Q2) the card is still offered after the first patient is added; R5 (Q2) an account whose patients were seeded before its first sign-in is offered the card on both lists. R6 (our boundary): account 3 taps Not now and signs out, account 4 signs in on the same browser and IS offered the baseline on both lists (no survey key in localStorage any more: the old shared-browser suggestion is fixed by #86), and account 3's Not now holds on a second device the same day. R7 (the days after Not now) is S14 A. R8 (our boundary): with the baseline answered, surveys:status no longer has baselineDone, and the pre-#86 card hides itself only on status.baselineDone (e02167f BaselineSurveyCard.tsx:102), so an app build from before #86 (store build 10, which talks to dev) would show the baseline again to physicians who answered it, every day after its 24 h snooze (candidate, not judged here: no store build was run). The 4 PM feedback card appeared after the answer because the run was after 16:00 (S14 B).

Evidence: 14 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: seed-second-account, session-control, multi-session, device-clock, browser-storage-read, permission-add-patient, backend-read-admin. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
